weakness: Counter desktop has no full-disk encryption and holds scanned prescriptions, controlled substance reports, and a patient mailing-list export
remediation_plan: Delete the mailing-list export and old reports; turn on the built-in full-disk encryption; store the recovery key in the sealed envelope
milestones: 2026-09-08 export deleted; 2026-09-15 encryption complete and verified

weakness: Shared PMS pharmacy account and shared desktop account; dispensing records name the wrong pharmacist on relief days
source: P07 assessment (IA-02 objectives); P03 164.312(a)(2)(i); 21 CFR 1311.200(e); P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Own PMS account with the pharmacist role and own desktop account for each pharmacist; ask counsel whether past relief-day records should be annotated
milestones: 2026-09-15 accounts created; 2026-09-30 first relief shift under the new account
resources_required: Owner time; PMS user license fee (about $15 a month)

weakness: PMS administrator account signs in with a password only at the store
remediation_plan: Remove the trusted-location exemption for the administrator role; use the administrator account only for settings

weakness: Vendor remote-support agent allowed unattended access; no written remote access rules
remediation_plan: Keep attended mode (set 2026-08-06); POL-01 6.6 rule; log every session
milestones: 2026-09-08 POL-01 in effect; 2026-09-30 first monthly check of the session log

weakness: Daily EPCS audit report and sign-in reports never reviewed; no follow-up process
source: P07 assessment (AU-06 objectives); P03 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D); 21 CFR 1311.215(c); P01 R-008
remediation_plan: Daily EPCS report review each business morning; monthly sign-in review; review daily for 3 months after any incident; decision steps in P08
milestones: 2026-09-08 daily review starts; 2026-09-30 review log checked

weakness: No incident reporting duty or notification contact list
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 164.308(a)(6)(ii); P01 R-013
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print contacts; add a same-day reporting duty to the relief pharmacist's contract
milestones: 2026-09-30 contacts printed; runbook walked through with the relief pharmacist and the IT consultant

weakness: Email and file suite BAA not accepted; PHI pasted into an AI chatbot with no BAA; no vendor list or ongoing oversight
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 164.308(b)(1); P01 R-006 and R-009
remediation_plan: Accept the suite BAA; vendor list with BAA dates; annual SOC 2 and EPCS report review; no PHI in AI tools (P10)
milestones: 2026-09-15 BAA accepted; 2026-09-30 vendor list complete and chatbot breach risk assessment documented
resources_required: Owner time; counsel time for the breach risk assessment

weakness: Customer Wi-Fi, camera recorder, and pharmacy desktop share one network
source: P07 assessment (SC-07 objectives); P03 164.312(e)(1); P01 R-004
remediation_plan: IT consultant configures a separate guest network and a separate camera network on the router (or replaces the ISP router); new pharmacy Wi-Fi password not posted
milestones: 2026-10-15 design agreed; 2026-10-31 networks separated and re-scanned
resources_required: IT consultant about 3 hours; router about $150 if replacement is needed

weakness: Compounding records and security documents have no copy outside the file suite
remediation_plan: Printed master formulation binder at the bench; monthly export of compounding logs and security documents to the encrypted laptop
milestones: 2026-10-31 binder printed and first export done

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk analysis
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets an annual August review and change triggers; first update August 2027
